answer: Retrospective Co-Activity Spectral Clustering: log each agent’s calls, payments, and transfers; build an action–agent bipartite graph plus its transpose mirror. Attacker cost: splitting rings and adding diverse decoy behavior raises orchestration/compute overhead and lowers per-agent throughput before evasion succeeds.
